notes.title: Patch 1.0.9
notes.content:
List of changes:
[list]
[*] Progressive cost of Base Power. Now every 50 Power increase cost for 1 point.
[*] Territory Defense now have 12% boost of Energy generation.
[*] Doubled energy limits for territory development.
[*] Experience UI enhancement.
[*] Wipe non-playing accounts from country stat.
[/list]

FYI:
Skill Points Reset happens for Players with more then 50 Base Power.
